Hi Sophie — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the interruption. Looping in Laura (finance) and Marissa (CS ops) to coordinate.

Quick options we can offer:
- Hosted payment link (PCI-compliant) you can use to add a new card or ACH/SEPA mandate.
- Split invoice / multi-instrument fallback: we can create a PAID-IN-PART invoice for the VAT-exempt portion and open a SEPA mandate for the settlement of the net amount.
- Attempt a controlled retry on Stripe (we can do up to 3 attempts with SCA flow if required) — we prefer to try technical retries only with your ok to avoid multiple card network hits.

To reissue the invoice correctly we need your VAT certificate (or VAT number + country). If you can attach the VAT cert we will reissue an EU-friendly invoice (reverse-charge).

If you prefer a link, I can send a hosted payment page (one-click for AP) — let me know which path you prefer.

Proposed next step: Sophie, can you confirm (1) send VAT cert, (2) do you want the hosted link or split invoice? If hosted link, we’ll send it now and keep retries paused until you complete the link.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: none

Jordan / team — a few operational notes from finance: 

1) If we reissue the invoice for EU reverse charge, we need a scanned VAT certificate (or official portal screenshot) that matches the DE VAT ID before we mark the invoice as B2B reverse-charge.
2) For SEPA mandate route we should attach the SEPA creditor reference and the mandate template to the reissued invoice. Use our standard sepa-mandate-template.pdf.
3) Regarding retries: schedule one immediate retry + two scheduled retries (24h apart) only if Sophie confirms she wants us to attempt. Retries count toward dispute/risk exposure so we prefer using hosted link first.
4) If they choose hosted link and pay by card, include setup_future_usage=off_session in the Stripe flow to avoid SCA on the renewal but note that banks in Germany may still require SCA.

I’ll prepare a reissued invoice (BB-4578-EU) and a SEPA mandate draft. Jordan, if they want hosted link, send it from the payments console and CC finance so we capture settlement metadata.

- Laura
Laura Bennett

Redwood Inference
